# Swap
[Git Source](https://github.com/tenbinlabs/tenbin-contracts/blob/64004be494549e5de52bb55a6490bd85d73a4f57/src/external/bebop/IBebopHook.sol)

Bepop interface for a single swap leg between taker and maker


```solidity
struct Swap {
uint256 takerAmount;
address takerToken;
uint256 makerAmount;
address makerToken;
}
```
